jobs.command: 0 * * * * sh -c 'if [ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ]; then npm run cron -- hourly; else echo "skip hourly"; fi'
0 8-18 * * * sh -c 'if [ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ]; then npm run cron -- business-hours; else echo "skip business-hours"; fi'
0 3 * * * sh -c 'if [ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ]; then npm run cron -- nightly; else echo "skip nightly"; fi'
0 8 * * * sh -c 'if [ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ]; then npm run cron -- morning; else echo "skip morning"; fi'
0 18 * * MON-FRI sh -c 'if [ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ]; then npm run cron -- weekday-evening; else echo "skip weekday-evening"; fi'
